title: SPLA/92/2016 of Dr. Atya Nand Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND ANOTHER

Office Notes,

Registrar's order
with Signatures
COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
SPLA No.92 of 2016
with
CRLA No.126 of 2016
Hon'ble R.C. Khulbe, J.
Ms. Manisha Bhandari, learned
counsel for the applicant-appellant.
 Ms. Mamta Joshi, learned Brief
Holder for the State.
Mr. Tajhar Qayyum, learned counsel
for respondent no.2.
This appeal is preferred u/s 372 of
the Cr.P.C against the judgment and order
dated 12.02.2016 passed by Special Judge
POCSO/Additional Session Judge,
Haldwani, Nainital in Sessions Trial
No.138 of 2014, "State vs. Akash Mandal
and others", whereby the trial Court
acquitted the accused-respondent no.2
Amandeep Sandhu u/s 21(2) of POCSO
Act, 2012. Leave to appeal is also
preferred.
The State has no objection.
Accordingly, the application for leave
to appeal is allowed.
Admit.
Summon Lower Court Record.
The Registry is directed to prepare

the paper-book and supply the same to
the learned counsel for both the parties,
as per rule.
The matter be listed after 25 days.
In the meantime, learned counsel for
the appellant will provide translated copy
of the FIR, statement of witness and
judgment.
